# I'm 28 today

i’m 28 today and i feel unbelievable, its been a long journey. If you know me before i was the type of kid who always think the sky is falling, that i’m not belong to this world, that i will join 27club like my fav artists Mac Miller, Kurt Cobain…

with that in mind, the only purpose for me to live is to have the fullest life, to remember every details, everyone passing my life, every moment we shared, i kept all of them in a private tiktok/youtube channel, no matter we had conflicts before or we are good buddies til now, no matter we still talk or no longer hangout, i appreciate all of you.

long story short i might be bitter when i left masan and still carried that pain til now, i saw it as my huge failure, its like a GTA mission and you failed, that day though i was the star of the team, i made big money, the leader really liked me and even treated me differently from others (all of our 1v1 meetings were at the bar down at sofitel hall meanwhile for others were just like normal between boss and staff) and it could be the easiest path to make impact to 1 mil people (also my dream). Though after all i just get bored and hated what i was doing then, i really dont know why i just know its not for me.

at this company, yah at first its not that easy for me to fit in, and ppl think i’m wasting time and my talent here. But they dont know how i’m so happy now, how i’m so excited in building cool shit though it may have zero impact, how i enjoy every little thing like putting my face out the window and feel the wind blow in my face, and after all its the friends i got here i love them all.

i dont know if i’ll be here long or i can live longer, just to you know i am and will appreciate every little moment with all of you.

life is beautiful isn’t it
